body:
Thank you for the work on 1.25.0, and for taking in our earlier corrections.
Running it on our test files with `-ENS`, we still found one case where the
nesting is wrong.

### The problem

The nested structures extension reads every `catch`, `for`, `if`, `finally`
and so on as a control structure, also when it is the name of a member. A
promise chain is enough:

```js
function load(p) {
  return p.then(() => 1).catch(() => null);
}
```

```
$ lizard -ENS ns.js          # master, 1119db8
       1      1      2      0       1     0 (anonymous)@2-2@ns.js
       1      1      2      0       1     1 (anonymous)@2-2@ns.js
       3      1     22      1       3     0 load@1-3@ns.js
```

The arrow function passed to `.catch` has NS 1, though it contains no
structure. `p?.catch(...)` behaves the same. For CCN these member names are
already excluded (#546).

### What changes

Only `lizard_ext/lizardns.py`. A structure word right after `.` or `?.` is
read as a member name. The extra comparison is reached only by tokens that are
not `{`, `;`, `}` or a structure word, and only with `-ENS`. With the fix:

```
       1      1      2      0       1     0 (anonymous)@2-2@ns.js
       1      1      2      0       1     0 (anonymous)@2-2@ns.js
       3      1     22      1       3     0 load@1-3@ns.js
```

### How it is tested

`test_member_named_like_a_structure_is_not_a_structure` in
`test/testJavaScriptNestedStructures.py` covers `.then(...).catch(...)`,
`?.catch` with a real `if` inside the callback, and `p.finally()` inside a
real `try`/`catch`. It fails on `master` without the change. The full suite
passes on the branch: `python -m pytest` gives 2927 passed, 7 skipped.
pycodestyle was not available here; the changed lines stay within the 120
columns of `setup.cfg`.

### Performance

Measured with `.agents/skills/lizard-process-pr/scripts/paired_benchmark.py`,
workload `api` with `--extension ns`, on a fixed corpus of 223 JavaScript and
201 TypeScript files (about 65,000 NLOC), against `master` 1119db8: the paired
95% interval of the slowdown is 0.67% to 0.81%, under the 3% bound. The
measurement ran with a local Python 3.13 virtual environment, not in the Nix
environment, which was not available here.

### What does not change

Structures written as statements, `try { } catch (e) { }` included, and the
Python path of the extension, which does not use this state machine.

Thanks for maintaining lizard and for taking the time to look at this.
title: Do not count a member named like a structure as a nested structure (NS)
